name: Classic
description: The original white-and-slate foundation, with editorial headings and a dark counterpart.
guidance: Preserve the original clean white/slate application foundation. Use serif headings, pill actions and generous neutral surfaces. Use the bundled local fonts and product compositions. Use the exported page/panel/row spacing and title scale consistently, with 44px action targets and brief 160ms interaction feedback. See docs/polish.md for the complete product contract.
